description: This file defines a report module for generating a job card summary in an ERP system, including data retrieval, chart data preparation, and column configuration.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate columns, data, and chart data for the report.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Retrieves job card data and associated time logs, processes statuses and times.

methods.name: get_chart_data
methods.description: Prepares chart data based on job card details and filters.

methods.name: prepare_chart_data
methods.description: Generates labels and periodic data for chart visualization based on date ranges and job card statuses.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the report table, including conditional columns based on filters.
